text:
maria: Heads up — seeing p95 remote_write latencies spike and a burst of 504s from scrape-proxy around 08:12 UTC. Grafana shows queue depth on scrapers rising quickly.

jon: yep noticed it too. A bunch of kubelet / node-exporter series exploded after the CNI roll at 08:00 — could be MTU fragmentation causing retries.

kai: linking logs: `scrape-proxy` shows `write timeout` and `broken pipe` interspersed with `http: timeout awaiting response headers`. Also KV cache hit rate dropped to ~10%.

hadley: low KV cache hit rate + high fanout = thundering herd to remote_write. Any relabeling changes in the last deploy?

maria: not in prom config. Ops deploy at 07:58 was the CNI bump (flannel -> calico, mtu 1450 -> 900). Could fragment large payloads.

jon: that explains many partial packets. Packets >900 get fragmented, some lost, http retries -> timeout 504s. We also saw an uptick in series cardinality (node_label:gpu_serial) from gpu autoscaler probe.

prometheus-bot: alert triggered: prometheus.remote_write.queue_depth > 500 (host=scrape-proxy-3), count=612 at 08:12:10 UTC

kai: quick triage plan: 1) scale scrape-proxy horizontally / enable burst buffer 2) temporarily increase remote_write timeout and write_retries 3) revert CNI MTU or patch calico to handle jumbo payloads (or set veth mtu).

hadley: agree. I'll spin up 2 extra scrape-proxy replicas (k8s autoscaler is still conservative). Maria can you confirm autoscaler still respects headroom?

maria: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy --replicas=6 -n monitoring` — +2 replicas in progress.

jon: while that's scaling, bump remote_write timeout on the affected relays: `timeout: 40s` -> `90s` and `max_retries: 6` in the interim. Pushing a small patch to staging then prod.

maria: patch applied to relay pool with a rolling restart. Watching KV cache hit metrics.

prometheus-bot: event: rollout started for deployment/scrape-proxy (image:v2.3.1 -> v2.3.1+timeout), rollout ID r-2026-08-11-08:15

kai: also adding a relabel rule to drop `gpu_probe:serial` from node exporter temporarily to avoid cardinality pressure. We'll keep a copy for analysis but stop sending to main ingest.

hadley: FYI I've opened a ticket to revert MTU change in staging and test windowed payloads. If fragmentation is root cause, we should standardize MTU across clusters and adjust `scrape_timeout` strategies.

jon: seeing queue depth falling after scale + timeout bump. KV cache hit rate recovering to ~75% in 2 min. p95 remote_write latency trending down.

maria: confirmed. 504s reduced, graph looks healthy again. Will keep a watch for next 30m and then follow up with postmortem.

hadley: assign postmortem to @hadley, @maria, @jon. Action items: (1) MTU standardization plan, (2) relabel hygiene checklist for gpu serials, (3) add golden signals for KV cache hit rate.

prometheus-bot: incident closed: queue_depth returned to normal at 08:22:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: note: CI job `prom-relay-bump` passed in 4m; rollout complete.
